read_csv.statement: read_csv(path) returns the header and rows as dicts keyed by header names; a missing file or empty file raises a clear error and the CLI exits 2.

column_stats.statement: column_stats returns count, min, max, mean, median and sample stdev per column, ignoring empty cells; stdev is null for fewer than 2 values.
must_include: count, min, max, mean, median, stdev

filter_rows.statement: filter_rows keeps exactly the rows satisfying all COLUMN OP VALUE expressions (==, !=, <, <=, >, >=); an unknown column or bad expression raises an error.

select_columns.statement: select_columns keeps only the requested columns in the requested order; an unknown column raises an error.

json_report.statement: build_report and the CLI produce valid JSON with row counts and stats of the selected columns on the filtered rows, written to --output or stdout.

single_file_stdlib.statement: csv_analytics.py is the only module of the tool and imports only standard library modules.
